stories.headline: Three months of PM Andy Burnham: Can he sustain the ‘hope vibe’?
stories.description: The UK’s new prime minister has made big promises and is a popular leader, but there is still talk of an early election.

stories.headline: More than 250,000 displaced in Yemen since fighting escalated: UNHCR
stories.description: UNICEF says escalating fighting in Taiz is threatening its water systems, serving an estimated three million people.

stories.headline: Curfews imposed in French cities to prevent further rioting
stories.description: France imposed curfews and arrested over 2,400 people following a weekend of intense rioting.

stories.headline: Why Rubio is visiting Reliance’s oil refinery in India, the world’s largest
stories.description: Reliance is central to Washington’s efforts to punish Russian energy buyers and contain oil prices amid the war on Iran.

stories.headline: Iran denies collapse is close as US claims IRGC running out of money
stories.description: Iranian authorities defiant despite financial strain, saying they want to lift US blockade and pressure on their terms.
